meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用谷歌的 Cirq（Python 库）帮你搭建与模拟量子电路、做参数扫描，把任务提交到 Google Quantum AI、IonQ 等后端，并做噪声建模与表征实验。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建、模拟或优化量子电路，提交到 Google Quantum AI 等硬件，或做噪声建模、量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 构建含 H 门和 CNOT 的两比特电路，并模拟 1000 次
say.note: 会返回测量结果的直方图

say.text: 给这个电路加上 depolarizing 噪声，比较不同强度的噪声结果
把电路提交到 IonQ QPU 上运行

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Google's Cirq Python library to build and simulate quantum circuits, perform parameter sweeps, submit jobs to backends such as Google Quantum AI or IonQ, and handle noise modeling and characterization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build, simulate, or optimize quantum circuits, run jobs on hardware such as Google Quantum AI, or perform noise modeling and characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to make a two-qubit circuit with H and CNOT and simulate it 1000 times
Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare different strengths
Submit the circuit to the IonQ QPU
